pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 18
   C. 77
   D. 36

5. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 81
   C. 10
   D. 9

6. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44
   C. 105
   D. 22

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
